artworks.title: Remi Du Laury
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Jacob van Oost II
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a seated man within an oval frame. The man faces left but looks directly at the viewer, with a round face, broad forehead, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. His gray, wavy hair reaches his neck, and he wears a fur-trimmed garment over a dark robe with a white collar showing at the neck. He holds a cross on a chain in his right hand and wears a ring on his little finger. The background is lightly shaded with a decorative emblem at the bottom, along with inscriptions in small font. The portrait is bordered with intricate lines and patterns.

artworks.title: Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is facing the viewer with a calm expression, with long, wavy hair, a broad forehead, curved eyebrows, and a relaxed mouth. They wear layered clothing and hold a rolled-up scroll with the year "1668" visible in their left hand. The background includes a tree, foliage, and a building with towers, suggesting a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Charles-Maurice Le Tellier
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated in a chair. He is facing forward, with a slight turn of his head, looking directly at the viewer. The man has curly hair framing his round face and appears calm. He wears clerical attire, with a robe, lace cuffs, and a star-shaped badge on his chest. He holds a piece of paper in his left hand. The background includes a draped curtain and a bookshelf filled with books.

artworks.title: Tobias and the Angel
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals walking through a forested area. One person is looking at the other, who is holding a staff. Both individuals wear robes. The background shows dense foliage and a large tree trunk. The etching emphasizes textured lines to show depth and shadow in the scene.

artworks.title: Knud Rasmussen
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man. He is in a three-quarter view looking to his right. His facial features include a prominent nose and pronounced cheekbones, with shadows emphasizing the contours of his face. His hair is dark and cut in a relatively short style, brushing across his forehead and covering his ears. He wears a coat with a large fur collar that envelops his upper body. The background has a textured pattern of dark vertical and horizontal lines, contrasting with the lightness of the man's skin. The etching style gives depth and texture to the portrait.

artworks.title: Manfred and Astarte (1st plate)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dramatic scene with a dynamic contrast of light and dark. One figure is kneeling with an arm raised, possibly in an act of reaching or warding something off, while being illuminated from the background. To the right, another figure is suggested with flowing lines, creating a sense of movement and ethereal presence. The use of sharp and soft lines, along with areas of intense darkness and bright highlights, conveys a sense of drama and tension within the scene. The overall composition creates an atmosphere of mystery and intensity.

artworks.title: Manfred and Astarte (2nd plate)
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in a dramatic scene. The male figure is kneeling with one leg bent and the other extended behind him, leaning backward with one arm propping him up. He has a beard, mustache, medium-length unkempt hair, and is dressed in a dark tunic. The female figure is standing with her body slightly leaning backward, raising her head and arm upwards as if in mid-movement. She has long flowing hair and is lightly draped in swirling fabric. The background is a textured, shadowy environment suggesting a rocky landscape under a moody sky.

artworks.title: Weeper: Study of a Nude Woman, Seated with Profile to Right
Duet from "The Trojans" (6th plate)
artworks.description: This print shows a woman depicted in a seated position. Her legs are bent, and she is leaning backward, resting against something unseen. The woman's face is pale, with a small nose and high cheekbones. She is looking to the left, and her lips are slightly parted. Her hair is styled back and adorned with a tiara-like accessory. She is draped in a flowing garment that cascades around her. To the left is a man kneeling by her side and looking up at her. He is holding one of her hands and is dressed in a similar flowing garment. His skin is also pale, and he has dark, curly hair and a dark beard. The background features dense foliage, and most of the print is very dark, making some details hard to see. Surrounding the print is a border of off-white paper with some words written on it.

artworks.title: Debut from "Paradise and the Peri" (2nd plate)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in an ethereal setting, focusing on their upper bodies. One person sits on the ground, looking upwards with long dark hair falling over their shoulders. Their facial features are obscured by shadows. They wear a flowing garment. The other figure stands to the right, with partly spread wings. They have lighter hair and wear a gown-like garment. Their right arm is raised, hand gesturing upwards. The background is textured, resembling a cloudy or stormy sky, creating a mysterious atmosphere. The image is in grayscale with shading and texture for depth.

artworks.title: Siegfried and the Rhine Maidens
artworks.description: The image is a textured drawing featuring multiple figures. The central figure is depicted from head to toe, standing upright with raised arm, possibly holding an object, and extended arm. The figure wears a loose, draped garment with indistinct facial features and dark hair blending into the background. Additional figures are seated or reclining with obscured facial features. The dark, smoky atmosphere surrounds them, suggesting a natural landscape. The composition is rendered in muted tones, creating a moody effect.

artworks.title: Pastoral
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered in a forest setting. The scene captures a group of figures engaged in activities within a low-lit forest clearing, surrounded by dense trees. To the left, one figure is holding up a circular object. The center figure appears to be seated with flowing garments, highlighted by patches of light. Two figures are seated in shadow to the right. The use of dark shadows and subtle highlights creates a sense of mystery and depth in the natural environment, while the texture adds an atmospheric quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Evocation of Kundry (2nd plate)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman on the left and a man on the right. The woman is shown with her arms raised and head tilted back. Her flowing hair partially obscures her face. She wears a long, light dress. The man has a beard and is sitting, pointing upward with one hand and resting the other on an open book. He wears a cloak and a turban or hat. In the background are high walls and a circular form, set in a dark, swirling texture.

artworks.title: Charles Meryon
artworks.description: The image shows a man reclining on a bed. He has dark, medium-length hair, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a long-sleeved top and partially covered with a blanket. The room is simply furnished, with a metal bed frame visible. The man is lying on a bed with a pillow behind him. The background shows a textured wall surface. The lighting casts a shadow of the man on the wall. The etching style emphasizes shadows and textures.

artworks.title: A Cup with Rams' Heads at the Foot
artworks.description: The image features an ornate vase with intricate floral and anthropomorphic motifs in black and ivory colors. The vase is prominently displayed against a plain background.

artworks.title: Le bouquet (The Bouquet)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing from the knees up. On the left is a woman in profile facing a man. She has her hair in a bun and wears a dress with a checkered pattern, holding a large envelope. The man on the right wears a suit with a top hat, holding a small piece of paper. The background consists of vertical lines, suggesting a wall, and there is a hint of a basket with coins near the woman. The setting appears simple, with minimal details indicating an indoor environment.

artworks.title: Danseuses dans leur loge (Dancers in Their Dressing Room)
artworks.description: The image shows two women, both depicted with only their upper bodies visible. The woman on the left stands with her side facing forward, her head turned slightly away, with arms bent at the elbows resting on her hips. She has her hair styled in an updo. She appears to be wearing a corset or similar undergarment, partially wrapped in a loosely draped fabric around her waist. The second woman, seated just behind the first, also only visible from the torso up, leans slightly back, her face angled slightly upwards, giving a clearer view of her facial features, and her hair also styled up. She has a loose robe or garment draped over her shoulders. The surrounding area is sparsely furnished, with what appears to be a table nearby holding small items, such as a bottle and possibly a dish, against a backdrop of vertical lines suggestive of wood paneling. The sketched background remains simple, defined by linework that conveys a sense of space without specific embellishments.

artworks.title: Le café de la Nouvelle Athènes (The Cafe of the New Athens)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a café scene with various patrons. It shows an interior setting with several figures gathered around a table. The lines are sketchy and drawn with ink. One of the elements is a woman in a striped dress facing away from the viewer. Beside her, there are men wearing top hats. On the table, there are glasses and a carafe. The background features linear patterns adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Le bar des Folies-Bergère (The Bar at the Folies-Bergère)
artworks.description: The image is an etching that shows a group of elegantly dressed men and women in a social scene. The drawing primarily shows their upper bodies, some in full view from the waist up. The people are standing or sitting in a convivial setting, engaging in conversation and interaction. A woman's face is in profile, wearing a straw hat adorned with decorative elements. She is dressed in a fitted jacket and a floor-length plaid skirt, holding a long, thin object. The men are wearing tall top hats and formal attire with detailed coats and jackets. The background is filled with cross-hatching, creating a textured atmosphere indicating an interior space with chairs and tables around. The overall composition depicts a lively and crowded scene of a social gathering.

artworks.title: A Bullier (To Bullier's)
artworks.description: This print shows two women with their arms linked. The woman on the left is turned towards the right, facing with the other woman. Her facial features are partially visible; she has a sharp nose and an upturned mouth. Her light hair is styled up and covered by a wide-brimmed light blue hat. She wears a red, form-fitting dress. The woman on the right is turned towards the other woman, and more of her face is visible. She has wide, dark eyes and is smiling. Her dark hair is styled up with a yellow hat resting on top. She wears a dress with a high neckline and what appears to be a black-and-white plaid design. Around her waist, there's a dark belt that cinches the outfit. The background behind the women is dark, with light circular shapes resembling streetlamps glowing behind them.

artworks.title: A Bullier (To Bullier's)
artworks.description: The image shows two women from head to waist standing next to each other, engaged in conversation. The woman on the left is positioned partly in profile, facing the woman on the right, while the woman on the right is turned slightly away, facing towards the left. Their faces are delicately featured, with one woman wearing a decorative hat with feathers and the other with a simpler headpiece. The woman on the left wears a dark blouse, while the woman on the right dons a patterned outfit. Both women have their hair styled up or tucked under their headwear. The background consists of a textured, abstract shading, with lighter areas suggesting sky or cloud formations.

artworks.title: Les Folies-Bergère (planche refusée, 2e planche) (The Folies Bergère) (refused plate, second plate)
artworks.description: The image shows three people at a small round table in an indoor setting. The woman on the left is sitting with her hands on the table, looking towards the viewer. The woman in the middle faces away, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with decorations. The man on the right stands, wearing a dark suit with a beard, smoking a pipe, and wearing a tall top hat. The background shows a dim café environment with blurred decor elements and another figure wearing hats. A small glass is on the table in front of the seated woman.

artworks.title: L'ambulante au parapluie (Walker with an Umbrella)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a full-length side profile. She has distinct facial features with shadows accentuating her cheekbones, and her hair is styled under a hat adorned with a decorative plume or flower. She wears a long, patterned dress with long sleeves and holds an umbrella under her arm. The background features a heavily hatched and cross-hatched pattern, with a lamp post casting light in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Le Traite des blanches (The White Slave Trade)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is standing with their body slightly turned to the right, looking downward, with long, flowing hair that drapes over their shoulders. The person on the right is facing left, wearing glasses and what appears to be a large, ornate hat adorned with feathers. They have a fuller figure, with facial features depicted in profile, and their hair is mostly concealed by the hat. This individual is wearing a shawl or wrap over a dress, and they hold a closed umbrella in front of them. There are no visible items of jewelry on either person. The background is a plain, textured surface with sketch-like vertical lines.
